name: Specieslike clusters based on identical ancestor points

mentions.name: Specieslike clusters based on identical ancestor points
mentions.description: An academic paper in mathematical biology, published in the Journal of Mathematical Biology, proposing a definition of species under which, for any organism in any species, the species consists almost entirely of that organism's descendants or almost entirely of non-descendants. The author is arranging talks and poster presentations at conferences and seminars to spread knowledge of the work.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on arranging talks and poster presentations at various conferences/seminars to spread knowledge of my latest academic paper, "Specieslike clusters based on identical ancestor points".
